questions.question: SFTP is used for:

options.A: Sending Files over the Internet in a secure manner
options.B: Sending Mail over the Internet in a secure manner

questions.explanation: SFTP (SSH File Transfer Protocol) transfers files securely over an encrypted SSH connection. It is not used for mail, video conferencing or chat.

questions.question: Consider a system with a total physical memory of 8 GB and total virtual memory of 16 GB. If the system is using 6 GB of physical memory and 10 GB of virtual memory, how much memory is being swapped out?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: Of the 10 GB of virtual memory in use, only 6 GB is resident in physical memory, so 10 - 6 = 4 GB must be swapped out to disk.

questions.question: Term, Data Structure refers to ........... and interrelationship between them.
questions.explanation: A data structure is the logical organization of data and the relationships among data elements.

questions.question: Variables which can be accessed by all modules of the program is called
questions.explanation: A global variable is declared outside all functions and can be accessed by every module of the program. Local and auto variables are visible only within their block.

questions.question: Convert the binary number 1011.1101 to its decimal equivalent. Which of the following is the correct decimal value?
questions.explanation: 1011 = 11 and .1101 = 0.5 + 0.25 + 0 + 0.0625 = 0.8125, so the value is 11.8125. None of the listed values matches.

questions.question: The quality of ___ remains unchanged even if the size is increased or decreased.
questions.explanation: Vector graphics are defined by mathematical shapes, so they scale without losing quality. Photographs and other raster images become pixelated when enlarged.

questions.question: What would you choose to create a pre-formatted slide style?
questions.explanation: A slide layout provides a pre-formatted arrangement of placeholders (title, text, content) for a slide. Slide sorter view is only for arranging slides.

questions.question: CD-ROM is a
questions.explanation: A CD-ROM is an optical storage medium read by a laser, so it is neither semiconductor nor magnetic memory; hence none of these. Magnetic memory is the tempting wrong choice (that is hard disk/tape).

questions.question: If circular queue is implemented using array having size MAX_SIZE in which array index starts with 0, front points to the first element in the queue, and rear points to the last element in the queue. Which one of the following conditions is used to specify that the circular queue is empty? - (A) Front=rear= 1

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: With front and rear pointing to actual elements, an empty queue is represented by front = rear = -1. front = rear = 0 means the queue holds exactly one element.

questions.question: Which memory management technique uses fixed-sized blocks of memory, allowing processes to be loaded into any available block?
questions.explanation: Paging divides memory into fixed-size frames, and any page can be loaded into any free frame. Segmentation uses variable-size segments.

questions.question: Internet works on

options.C: both packet switching and circuit switching

questions.explanation: The internet is a packet-switched network: data is split into packets routed independently. Circuit switching is used by traditional telephone networks.

questions.question: Which of the following is a software development life cycle model?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: Waterfall, Agile and Spiral are all software development life cycle models.

questions.question: Which of the following commands is correct to delete the values in the relation teaches?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: DELETE FROM teaches; removes all tuples while keeping the table. Option B deletes only rows whose Id is the string 'Null', and REMOVE TABLE is not SQL.

questions.question: Which concept allows a subclass to provide a specific implementation of a method that is already defined in the superclass?
questions.explanation: Overriding lets a subclass provide its own implementation of a method already defined in its superclass with the same signature. Overloading means same name with different parameters in the same scope.

questions.question: Which data structure often results in a time-space tradeoff by using extra memory to speed up operations?
questions.explanation: Hash tables allocate extra (often sparse) memory slots to achieve average O(1) search, insertion and deletion, a classic time-space tradeoff. Arrays, linked lists and stacks do not trade memory for speed in this way.

questions.concept: Cell Value Is and Formula Is
questions.question: You can check the conditions against ......... when applying conditional formatting.
questions.explanation: Conditional formatting conditions can be based on the cell value (Cell Value Is) or on a formula (Formula Is), so both.

questions.question: Which JavaScript method is used to add a new HTML element to the DOM?
questions.explanation: document.createElement() creates the new element node (which is then attached with appendChild()). appendElement(), newElement() and addElement() are not DOM methods.

questions.question: Which one is not a physical threat?
questions.explanation: Hacking is a logical (cyber) threat carried out over software and networks. Storm, fire and flood are physical threats to computer systems.

questions.question: Which of the following features must be supported by any programming language to become a pure object-oriented programming language?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: A pure object-oriented language must support encapsulation, inheritance and polymorphism (among others). Since all three are required, the answer is 'More than one of the above'.

questions.question: The term "Data" refers to:

options.A: The electronic representation of the information(or data)

questions.explanation: Data are raw facts and figures that become information after processing. Option A describes information rather than data.

questions.question: Which of the following could be a disadvantage of 'open source' software?

options.A: High quality software with lots of features
options.C: May not have been tested as much as proprietary software so might have bugs
options.D: You can edit the source code to customize it

questions.explanation: A possible drawback of open source software is that it may not be tested as rigorously as commercial software and so may contain bugs. Being editable and customizable are advantages.

questions.question: Two devices are in network, if

options.A: A process in one device is able to exchange information with a process in another device
options.B: a process is running on both devices
options.C: PIDs of the processes running on different devices are same

questions.explanation: Two devices are said to be in a network if a process in one device can exchange information with a process in another device.

questions.question: Segmentation is a memory management technique where memory is divided into segments, with each segment containing:
questions.explanation: Segmentation divides a program into logical segments (code, data, stack) of variable size. Fixed-size blocks describe paging.

questions.question: Which statement is used to retrieve data from a database in SQL?
questions.explanation: SELECT retrieves (queries) data from tables. UPDATE, DELETE and INSERT modify data.

questions.question: The logic gate that provides high output for same input is

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: An XNOR gate gives output 1 when both inputs are equal. XOR gives 1 when inputs differ, and NOT has a single input.
